item.title: Greece Hails UN Vote Extending Cyprus Peacekeeping Mission
item.description: Greece’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs welcomed the adoption of UN Security Council Resolution 2815, which renews the mandate of the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) for an additional 12 months. item.description: Egypt and Greece have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen cooperation in creative industries and handicrafts, with the goal of expanding Egyptian products into European markets through Greece. item.title: Australia Holds Second Highest Household Debt; Greece 33rd
item.description: Greece, Cyprus, and Australia rank among the top 35 countries globally for household debt, according to new data from the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Australia leads the trio, placing 2nd worldwide with debt at 112% of GDP, Cyprus ranks 20th at 59.6%, while Greece sits 33rd with 38.8%. item.description: Greek police dismantled a criminal gang trafficking drugs within the Zografou University Campus in Athens, arresting four men aged 22, 27, 36, and 49, during a coordinated operation on Friday morning, 30 January.
